capabilities: Formats Fountain scripts as you type
Completes character names and sets line types with Tab
Renames a character throughout a script
Shows script outline, page breaks and runtime estimates
Exports scripts to stage-play PDFs in house styles
extras: Only one plugin can open .fountain files at a time, so other Fountain plugins must be turned off. Custom styles are JSON files that Obsidian cannot edit, so an external text editor is needed.
intentEvidence: A script outline in the sidebar, since Obsidian's own outline only reads notes.
problem: Obsidian's editor and outline are built for notes, so writing Fountain scripts, tracking characters and scenes, and producing properly formatted stage-play PDFs needs another tool.

relations.evidence: PDF export in stage-play house styles, ported from fountain2pdf

summary: Fountain script editor with as-you-type formatting, character completion, script outline, runtime estimates and stage-play PDF export in house styles.
